text1: A heavy tug refitted around a fishing harpoon launcher and the deck crews who keep it working. Its recovery gear turns a spent harpoon round in the time it takes to bring the catch aboard, so a crew that finds its mark rarely waits on the launcher.

The Stigmata's fishing harpoon is quite capable of punching through a ship's armour. Once embedded, its ROD head anchors a tether between the two ships. The line pays out no further than the distance at impact; which ship ends up towing the other depends on their mass and thrust.

Shields deflect the head. Firing again releases the tether.
Briefly increases the tug's mass, acceleration and turning ability, helping it pull a tethered ship off course. The extra power comes with a conspicuous engine flare.
text3: Increases mass and manoeuvrability for towing.

text1: A trawler rebuilt to carry Breach Lights well beyond what an ordinary rig can power. Its lens arrays spread each beam into a wide fan, opening a broad stretch of open space for every crew in the fleet to work.
A tender with deep bays, handling frames and launch racks for a full swarm of LYNE drones. Its deck crews service every drone that comes home and send the whole swarm straight back out.
This fighter-sized LYNE drone retrieves wrecked enemy fighters for its tender. Salvage clamps hold the wreck during the tow; repairs are left to the crew aboard ship.

Launches all repaired fighters from the salvage bays. They form wings of the usual size, or smaller wings if too few are available. They return for rearming or when recalled, and can be launched again. Destroyed fighters are not replaced.
